title: Freestanding 4-Arm Swing Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage without drilling with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand. Four pivoting arms provide space to hang and separate towels, helping you maximize bathroom space.

Highlights:
- Freestanding towel stand (no wall mounting) for bathrooms, powder rooms, and guest baths
- Four pivoting swing arms for versatile towel storage and organization
- Solid brass construction designed to resist rust and corrosion
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent floor scratching
- Part of the Soho collection for coordinated transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Collection: Soho
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Freestanding
- Dimensions: 12-Inch L x 9.25-Inch W x 49-Inch H
- Diameter: 1-Inch
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Product weight: 13.6 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included items: Towel stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.description: This elegantly designed free standing swing arm towel stand provides a convenient and stylish space to hang your favorite towels. Towel stand has 4 pivoting arms so that you can maximize your space. Large base is weighted to help prevent tipping. Towel stand is made of the finest solid brass materials so that it will not rust or corrode and is provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
